title: SkillOpt held-out gate verdict (ONE contract, 2026-10-30 WS-5 R3)
description: Written by the skillopt-validation-gate (agent or script) next to a proposal as <skill>.verdict.json. Read by scripts/skillopt-batch.sh promote_candidate, the skillopt-applier agent, services/learningEngine.ts assertApproveVerdict and the proxy's loop state. A skill file changes ONLY on verdict=APPROVE.

discrimination_before.description: The incumbent's score on the held-out split (0..1 pass rate or mean judge score).

discrimination_after.description: The candidate's score on the same held-out split.

golden_set_version.description: Version of the held-out set the comparison ran on (evals/cases or the golden set).

checks.description: The 8-check rubric, one row per check.

pareto.description: The candidate's metric vector from the pool file, when the proposer ran a pool.
